dict.string: Zeno goes quiet during your classes and meetings, and gives you a heads-up before they start. Events stay on this Mac.
When you turn on “Hey Zeno”, this Mac listens for Zeno’s name with Apple’s on-device speech recognition. Nothing you say leaves the Mac or is kept.
Zeno listens when you tap it, so you can say what you picked up the phone for. Audio goes to Google Gemini for the reply and isn't stored.
